features.sottotitolo: Six integrated applications plus shared services, with one registry and a single login.

presenze.sottotitolo: Clock-ins, shifts and timesheets ready for payroll.

timbrature.title: Clock in anywhere
timbrature.text: From smartphone or computer, with the site QR code, at a shared kiosk with PIN or badge; location check and clock-ins even without a connection.

dettaglio.intro: Employees clock in and out from their smartphone or computer browser, with nothing to install. Each site chooses how clock-ins are accepted.
punti: Clock in from the phone by scanning the QR station code, which changes every few seconds
Kiosk on a shared device at the site, with personal PIN or badge
Location check per site: no check, flag the clock-in or reject it
Without a connection the clock-in stays on the phone and is sent on reconnect
Clock in on a department and activity, when the company requires it
Correction requests for forgotten or wrong clock-ins

turni.title: Shifts and planning
turni.text: Shifts per department with minimum coverage, conflicts with holidays and leave highlighted, shift swaps between colleagues with approval.

dettaglio.intro: For shift-based work: define the shifts, plan them by department, and let employees see and swap their own.
punti: Shifts with hours and colour; on shift days the shift's hours apply
Minimum coverage per shift and department, with shortfalls flagged in the plan
Weekly or monthly planning, even with more than one shift on the same day
Copy a week to the selected employees
Shifts on holiday or leave days highlighted as conflicts
Swap or hand over a shift to a colleague, then manager approval

smartWorking.title: Remote working
smartWorking.text: Signed individual agreements, a remote-working calendar and a weekly day limit.

dettaglio.intro: Manages remote working from the individual agreement to single days: HR sets the rules, employees request days from the calendar.
punti: Individual agreement with period, allowed days and maximum days per week
Employee acknowledgement; with Document Management active, an agreement record to sign
Days can be requested only with a signed agreement and within its limits
Monthly calendar with approved and pending days and the weekly count
Requests decided by the same approvers as other requests
On approved remote-working days the location check does not apply

richieste.title: Requests and approvals
richieste.text: Holidays, leave, overtime and time bank: every request reaches the department approver.

dettaglio.intro: Employees request holidays, leave, overtime and corrections from their phone; the request reaches their department approvers, who approve or reject it.
punti: Absences for full days or by the hour, with an optional note
Holiday and leave balances, with a warning or block when insufficient
Hours credited to the time bank, recovered with a dedicated absence type
Approval by one manager, by all, or in hierarchical order
Approved requests are withdrawn with a revocation, which also needs approval
Requests also by voice or chat with the assistant

noteSpese.title: Expenses and mileage
noteSpese.text: Expenses with receipts attached and mileage refunds calculated on the employee's vehicles.

dettaglio.intro: Employees collect a trip's expenses in a single report with receipts; the manager reviews it and approves it in one step.
punti: Several expenses per report, each with date, type, amount and description
Receipts and invoices attached as PDF or photos
Mileage refund calculated from kilometres driven and the rate of the employee's car
Expense types defined by the company, generic or mileage-based
Expense review by employee or by type, with a chart too
Editable while pending; once approved, a revocation is requested

anomalie.title: Anomalies and days to fix
anomalie.text: Odd clock-ins, recurring delays and unbalanced days explained by AI, with an absence forecast.

dettaglio.intro: For whoever closes the month: shows the days to fix before the payroll export and estimates absences in the coming days. Department admins see only their own employees.
punti: In red what blocks the export: odd clock-ins, days without clock-ins, pending requests
In orange the warnings to check, kept apart from the days to fix
Recurring delays per employee, with count and average minutes
Explain button: AI summarises the calculated anomalies in plain words
Absence forecast from history and the holiday plan, with peak days
Days-to-fix and expected-absences widgets on the dashboard

commesse.title: Job costing
commesse.text: Timesheet hours at hourly cost plus expenses: costs and margin of every job, with a PDF report.

dettaglio.intro: To see what each job costs and earns: combines employees' worked hours and expenses over the months you choose.
punti: Staff cost: timesheet hours multiplied by the employee's hourly cost
Default hourly cost for those without their own
Approved expenses split across sub-jobs in proportion to hours
Revenue, total cost and margin per job and sub-job
Days not counted and expenses without a job are flagged
PDF report and a widget with the month's hours on jobs

paghe.title: Monthly check and payroll export
paghe.text: Review the month's timesheets, approve them in bulk and export them in your payroll consultant's formats.

dettaglio.intro: Closing the month in two steps: review and approve the timesheets, then prepare the file for your payroll consultant's software.
punti: For each employee hours worked, extra, additional, overtime and not recognised
Timesheets stay provisional until the month ends and authorisations are decided
Select the closed timesheets and approve them in bulk
Corrections from the HR calendar, recalculating the day or the month
Export templates: AI builds the format from the payroll software's file layout
File prepared in the background, with warnings such as missing employee numbers

Sales status, owner, source and tags for each customer
Contact people with role, phone, email and main contact
Consent to marketing communications with its date, on customers and leads
A lead converted into a new or existing customer, with an opportunity too

List view as an alternative to columns
Value, probability and expected close date for each opportunity
Loss reason required when an opportunity is closed as lost
History of every stage change in the opportunity card

Filter to show only the activities assigned to you
Outcome recorded when the activity is marked as done
Pop-up reminder before it starts, with notice set by the company
Assigned activities shown in your personal calendar through an .ics feed
Activity types configurable in the CRM tables

Yearly numbering with prefix and default validity
PDF with the company's terms, sent by email as an attachment

List with open requests, those assigned to you and urgent ones highlighted
Request history in the customer card

pricing.sottotitolo: One plan with all six applications, or only the ones you need: start for free.
pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. The bundle includes attendance, CRM, documents, human resources, compliance and company assets; you can activate or deactivate an application at any time.

scelta.domanda: Do I have to activate all the applications?
scelta.risposta: No: activate only the ones you need and add the others whenever you want. The bundle gives you all six.

dati.domanda: Is data shared between the applications?
dati.risposta: Yes: customers, employees, sites and vehicles are a single registry, used by all active applications.

collegamenti.risposta: Yes: handover reports for equipment and PPE are signed in Documents, fleet vehicles are used for mileage refunds in Attendance and every deadline ends up in the same schedule.

installare.domanda: Do I need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No, it works from the browser and from your smartphone.

consulente.risposta: Yes, the firm follows your companies with its own login: it uploads payslips, manages the GDPR record and receives the weekly summary.
